Tough loss—GG.

Looks like I mis-tracked the opponent’s HP under partial info. At Turn 16 I assumed they were at 10 HP, but they must have been at 30. Attacking from 10 HP into an opponent at 30 lets them survive at 10 and KO me on their turn. The safer line at 10 HP, unless you’re certain the opponent is at 20 or less, is to use a potion to avoid immediate lethal and force an extra exchange.
